items.text: Hello Puzzle Solvers,
Case Solved: The London Files just got two brand new cases.

Version 1.2 adds Case 4: On the House and Case 5: The Voice to the main game, taking it from 3 cases to 5. That is 10 new stages, the biggest addition since launch. This is the content update so many of you asked for.

Version 1.2 also brings revised translations for the first three cases and a round of fixes. Every change here comes straight from what you reported, so thank you once more. Your engagement made this update possible.

Case 4 – On the House: New case with 5 stages. During an informal gathering at the pub, the Image Consultant to a small circle of clients is found dead. It falls to Scotland Yard to determine whether it was a sudden illness or murder.
Case 5 – The Voice: New case with 5 stages. A loose end from the last case has left the Detective ill at ease: what if all the crimes so far are connected?
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45900389/599a63794368c7e5a61bcbe7f7392e4a1d7f410d.png"]
Interaction: Clicks now prioritize evidence, hidden objects and characters. Click areas in Cases 1, 2 and 3 have been adjusted.
Deduction Board: Long text on the board and in the final clue now shrinks to fit.
Bug Fixing: Various small fixes across the game’s systems.
Cases 1, 2 and 3: revised translations make the text clearer and more consistent across all languages.

We have also read the feedback about how the Classified Files are unlocked. It did not change in this version because we put 1.2 entirely into new content for the main game, which was the request we heard most often. It is next in line, and we will have more to say about it soon.

notes.title: Already own the game? The new cases are yours

items.text: Case 4 and Case 5 are part of version 1.2, so if you already have Case Solved: The London Files, they are waiting for you. Just update and play.
If you already solved everything and want to help, recommending it to another puzzle solving friend is the best thing you can do for a studio our size. The logic is flawless on this case.
[dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/4127360/Case_Solved_The_London_Files/"]
Thoughts, suggestions, criticism: drop them in our feedback thread: Share your thoughts & feedback here!
Bugs and technical issues: send them straight through our bug report form: playcasesolved.com/bug-report
For bugs, telling us what you were doing and (if you can) attaching a screenshot makes a big difference in how fast we can fix it.
We keep reading everything, and more fixes and improvements are already in the works. As always, we will post here when the next update is ready.
And if you're enjoying the game, leaving a review helps a small studio like ours a lot.
Happy solving,
Minimol Games

releases.displayName: Major Demo Update: New Clue Collection System

items.text: We’ve made significant changes to how clues are collected in Case Solved, based directly on your feedback.
Previously, some players told us that collecting clues felt monotonous or like a step that didn’t add much to the investigation. We took that seriously.
With this update, collecting clues is now an active part of the investigation.

notes.title: Instead of simply receiving information, you now need to

items.text: talk to suspects to get direction on what to look for
observe the environment
and find hidden objects in the scene to uncover clues
The goal is to make clue collection feel more natural and meaningful.
🔧 Fixes
Improved translations for better consistency and clarity
✨ Improvements
New clue collection system with hidden objects in the scene
Changes to the mission system to better support finding hidden objects
Interface updates to improve clarity and flow
This is an important step for the game, and your feedback continues to shape these changes.

notes.title: If you try the updated demo, we’d love to know

items.text: if clue collection feels more engaging now
and how this change affects the overall investigation flow
You can share your demo feedback in this thread.
Thanks for helping us improve Case Solved and thanks for investigating with us. 🕵️‍♂️

releases.displayName: New Demo Update: A New Hint System (Now in Testing)

items.text: We’ve just updated the demo with a new hint system, and we’d love your help testing it.
Previously, hints worked in a very direct way: you pressed the hint button, and a correct entry appeared in the logic table.
With this update, hints work differently.
You’ll now see a message on the hint button showing “found 0 of X hints”:

[img src="data:image/png;base64,"]
To unlock hints, you need to find hidden elements in the scene. Each one you discover grants a hint you can use during the investigation.
At the beginning, you might not feel the need to use hints, since the early cases are more approachable.
But trust us, in later phases, they might just save you 😉
The goal is to make hints feel more connected to observation and exploration, while keeping deduction at the center of the experience.
This is an experimental system, and your feedback is essential.

notes.title: If you try the updated demo, we’d love to hear

items.text: how this new hint system feels
whether it fits naturally into your investigation flow
if it helps without giving too much away
Please give it a try and share your thoughts with us.
Your feedback will help us decide how this system evolves.

releases.displayName: Detective Fest is live + Demo Update!

items.text: The Steam Detective Fest has officially started, and we’ve just released the first update for the Case Solved demo.
This update includes fixes and improvements directly based on the feedback we’ve been receiving from players.
Your comments have been incredibly helpful in highlighting what needed polish and where the experience could be clearer.
🔧 Fixes
Fixed several minor bugs that were affecting the overall experience
Improved translations for better consistency and clarity
Fixed text spacing and alignment issues in the logic table
✨ Improvements
Added new emojis to dialogues
Improved quality of life when swapping options while filling the logic table
Adjusted the tutorial to make learning clearer and smoother
If you’re playing the demo during Detective Fest, this update is already live.
It’s been essential for us, and it’s already helping shape a better final version of the game.
Please keep the feedback coming! It truly makes a difference. You can post them here: https://steamcommunity.com/app/4127360/discussions/0/693123651146538537/
Enjoy Detective Fest, and thanks for investigating with us!
